missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Мужчина' stays in the nominative as the subject, despite its feminine-looking ending it is grammatically masculine. 'Этот' and 'высокий' both take masculine forms to agree.

Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate masculine noun. 'Мужчину' is the accusative direct object of 'вижу'. As an animate noun the accusative equals the genitive-style ending, and 'знакомого' agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Мужчины' is the genitive form showing whose car it is. 'Того' is the agreeing masculine genitive demonstrative.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Мужчине' is the dative form required by 'помогать', marking the man as the one helped. 'Пожилому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Мужчиной' is the instrumental form after 'с', expressing accompaniment. 'Этим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О мужчине' uses the prepositional form after 'об' to express the topic. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. 'Мужчины' is the genitive singular form required by 'два'. 'За столом' is the instrumental location of where they sit.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Мужчины' is the nominative plural subject of 'сидели'. 'Взрослые' agrees in the plural, and 'в зале' is the prepositional location.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural of animate nouns. 'Мужчин' is the accusative plural, which for animate nouns equals the genitive plural. 'Этих' agrees in the animate accusative plural, and 'давно' adds time.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Мужчины' is the genitive form required after the negation 'нет'. 'Ни одного' reinforces the complete absence in the masculine genitive.
